biggest_catch: The $600/$800 is the BUSINESS checking bonus: you must hold a $10,000+ daily balance for 3 months for the $450 core piece, open online for the extra $50, and add merchant services that process $1,000+ ($600 tier) or $10,000+ ($800 tier) in card sales within 45 days — and the cash bonus doesn't arrive until the first business day after 120 days from opening.
catches: Business checking bonus only for the $600/$800 tiers; the personal checking bonus is a separate $400 ($100 + $50 online + $250 savings).
$450 is earned when a new primary business checking account maintains a daily balance of $10,000.00 or more during each of the initial 3 months, with online banking and EZ statements.
Extra $50 if you open the new business checking account online.

Up to $300 merchant services credit: $100 for $1,000–$5,000 in card sales processed in the first 45 days of activation, $200 for $5,000.01–$10,000, $300 for over $10,000 — so $600 = $450 + $50 + $100 merchant tier; $800 = $450 + $50 + $300 merchant tier.
All requirements must be satisfied within 120 calendar days of account opening.
Cash bonus deposited on the first business day after 120 calendar days from account opening; merchant credit paid within 30 days after the 45th day of processing.
Existing business checking holders are only eligible for the Merchant Services bonus.
Clients may receive only one new account opening-related bonus per calendar year; offer cannot be combined with any other offer.
Fidelity Bank employees and their immediate family are not eligible.
Offer 'valid as of 09-15-2025 and may be rescinded or changed at any time' — no fixed end date, but the bank can pull it.

steps: Open a new primary Fidelity Bank business checking account online (earns the extra $50 vs. in-branch).
Sign up for business online banking with EZ statements.
Maintain a daily balance of $10,000.00 or more during each of the initial 3 months.

Add Merchant Services through Fidelity Bank and process credit card transactions for 45 days: $1,000–$5,000 in sales in the first 45 days earns a $100 credit (for the $600 tier); over $10,000 earns the $300 credit (for the $800 tier).
Complete all requirements within 120 calendar days of account opening.

The cash reward bonus is deposited into your Fidelity Bank checking account on the first business day after 120 calendar days from account opening; the merchant services credit arrives within 30 days after the 45th day of processing.
timing: Account cash reward deposited on the first business day after 120 calendar days from account opening; merchant services credit within 30 days after the 45th day of processing. All requirements must be met within 120 days.
